BiblicalUsage: Zaham is named once, in 2 Chronicles 11:19. In 2 Chronicles 11:19 we read, "Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham."
TheologicalSignificance: Zaham is enough for God to remember a life, and I hold that a single mention counts.
